synthesis:draft.headline: VIC1 five‑minute price peak 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z).
summary: The AEMO market notice 'Inter-regional transfer limit variation - Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie 220kV' gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z), after the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and after the last five-minute interval at-or-above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:45 AEST).
The five-minute RRP peak in VIC1 was 406.00544 $/MWh (interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).
Six five-minute intervals met the analysis threshold of 300.0 $/MWh in the window.
Operational demand in the half-hour containing the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) was 6812.0 MW; the window maximum operational demand was 7485.0 MW.
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the five-minute peak was 6639.92 MW, and net interchange at that interval was -718.24 (net flow into VIC1).
The AEMO market notice text is included under published_findings.

possible_explanations.statement: The Hazelwood PS 4/6 bus‑tie short notice outage notice [c1] might not be contemporaneous with the 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the Network Outage Scheduler / MMS constraint invocation timestamps for the V-NIL_HW_TIE constraint set with the 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z–2026-08-19T23:45:00Z five‑minute intervals to see if the constraint was active at those times.

possible_explanations.statement: A short‑term supply/demand imbalance or rapid unit offer/dispatch changes might have produced the five‑minute price spike (independent of the Hazelwood notice) and could be consistent with the dispatch TOTALDEMAND and net interchange values at the peak.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine per‑unit SCADA time series, unit offer/bid changes and MMS constraint binding records for intervals ending 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z–2026-08-19T23:15:00Z to determine whether a unit trip, offer change or binding constraint coincided with the spike.

possible_explanations.statement: A constraint invoked for the Hazelwood bus‑tie (or another network element) could have affected interconnector limits and prices, which might be referenced by the notice [c1].
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Retrieve the MMS constraint set history and constraint binding records for V-NIL_HW_TIE and for any constraints that reference interconnectors T-V-MNSP1,V-SA,VIC1-NSW1 for timestamps around 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z–2026-08-19T23:30:00Z and compare them with dispatch prices.
